rules.title: Prohibition on use and sale of coordinated pricing algorithms
rules.requirement: Unlawful to sell, license, or otherwise provide to Berkeley landlords, or use, coordinated pricing algorithms that use non-public Competitor Data (less than 90 days old) to recommend rents, fees, occupancy rates or other lease terms in coordination between a landlord and its competitors, including through a third-party vendor. Excludes aggregated anonymous reports, affordable-housing limit tools, and market research, appraisal, and software research, testing or training uses. The chapter does not regulate the amount of rent a landlord may charge.

coverage.summary: Applies to sale, licensing and use of coordinated pricing algorithms for residential dwelling units in Berkeley.

rules.exemptions: Products or processes that publish aggregated, anonymous rental data without recommending rents, fees or occupancy; products used to set rent or income limits under affordable housing guidelines; use of information for market research for project financing, appraisal, or research, testing or training for software development.
rules.effective_date_note: Ordinance No. 7,992-N.S. effective date is not stated in the retrieved passages. A secondary source (DX06) reports ch. 13.63 as effective January 2026.
